headline: Germany's Economy Grew Only 0.1% in the Third Quarter
summary: Germany's economy expanded 0.1% in the third quarter, following growth of 0.4% in the first quarter and 0.3% in the second. The figures show a slowing pace.
why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and its growth data shapes expectations for euro-area policy and corporate earnings.
